purpose: Qualify the v8 lifecycle publication on the lcd nub: after the R81 construction probe reaches 0x1ff, e5_display_publish allocates E5Display, runs init, attaches to the lcd provider nub, starts it (E5Display::start now returns true; no hardware is touched), issues registerService, and confirms the service is visible via copyMatchingService(name 'E5Display'). Deviation from the D0 plan's conservative ladder is documented in docs/display-construction-probe.md; the nine backend slots stay guarded and the headless fixture keeps every consumer away.

payload.data_fixture: headless v3 (SpringBoard/liveactivitiesd/watchdogd disabled); card Data LBAs untouched by this flash cycle, R81-verified fixture hash fe0619f0 remains the card state by construction
payload.command_line: E5 boot serial=3 debug=0x14E e5-rootauth-off e5-exec-policy-off e5-uplink e5-fb e5-systemos e5-systemos-boot e5-data

open_items: E5Display publication is inert: the nine guarded backend slots (211,213,245,246,306,307,337,338,345) panic on any premature consumer; SpringBoard must stay disabled until the E5 lifecycle surface (open/swaps/wake) is implemented.
lcd has no indexed IODeviceMemory; the checked RGB565 boot-video mapping (0xbe000000,320x480,row640) still needs an explicit verified mapping step per the plan.
userclient open path (IOMobileFramebufferUserClient) untested; original newUserClient binding is linked and registered.
